vendor.title: DiscoSign: Discourse-Aware Text to Sign Language Gloss Translation
vendor.teaser: Sign language processing systems have traditionally operated at the sentence level, ignoring critical discourse phenomena fundamental to sign language comprehension.

vendor.title: AWS HealthOmics now publishes real-time run metrics to Amazon CloudWatch
vendor.teaser: AWS HealthOmics now publishes real-time run metrics to Amazon CloudWatch, giving you visibility into workflow resource utilization as runs execute. The 14 new run metrics span CPU and GPU usage, memory usage, file system usage and I/O metrics, network throughput, and ephemeral storage usage.

vendor.title: CloudWatch Network Monitor now provides NHI for Transit Gateway peering
vendor.teaser: Today, AWS announces that Amazon CloudWatch Network Monitor synthetic monitoring now provides its network health indicator (NHI) for paths that reach a destination across an AWS Transit Gateway inter-Region peering connection.

vendor.title: GitHub Copilot is now available in the AI SDK harness layer
vendor.teaser: GitHub Copilot now runs through the AI SDK harness layer via @ai-sdk/harness-github-copilot, using the same HarnessAgent interface as every other supported harness.

vendor.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
vendor.teaser: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services, combining built-in financial data and GPT-6 Astra for research, modeling, and client-ready materials.

vendor.title: The Economics of Agent Optimization: How AI agent governance controls cost and proves ROI
vendor.teaser: This blog post is the fourth and final installment of The Economics of Agent Optimization, which shares the strategies, capabilities, and proof points that can help you optimize agent costs and run AI as a managed investment system on Microsoft Foundry.

vendor.title: AI governance: What it is and why it's crucial for every business
vendor.teaser: AI is doing more on behalf of companies every day. And when something goes wrong—a corrupted record, an unauthorized action, a decision made on your behalf that you never approved—someone has to be accountable.

vendor.title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.
vendor.teaser: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action while the policy window remains open.

vendor.title: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra Now on Snowflake Cortex AI
vendor.teaser: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra is now in private preview on Snowflake Cortex AI. Use its frontier reasoning and computer use across Snowflake CoCo, CoWork, Cortex Agents, AI Functions and Cortex Inference — all inside Snowflake's governance perimeter.

vendor.teaser: Enterprise Brain launches with team-level Agent Memory, plus new WRITER Meet and WRITER for Slack and Microsoft Teams, bringing shared enterprise context to every conversation, agent workflow, and customer touchpoint The post WRITER Unveils Enterprise Brain, the First Universal Context Layer to

stories.title: US legislators push AI safety laws amid human extinction warnings
stories.teaser: Several AI researchers have publicly warned that artificial intelligence could cause human extinction within the next decade, prompting urgent action from U.S. lawmakers. Anthropic employees Jacob Coxon and Evan Hubinger posted that people building AI genuinely fear it could kill everyone, with Hubinger estimating over a 10 percent chance within ten years.

stories.title: OpenAI Calls for Mandatory National AI Safety Rules
stories.teaser: OpenAI is calling for mandatory national regulations on artificial intelligence that adapt as the technology becomes more powerful. The company's Chief Global Affairs Officer Chris Lehane stated in a blog post that regulators and developers have a limited time window to establish guardrails and policies before AI models grow even more capable.

stories.title: UNT receives transformative USD 20 mn gift from alumnus Vikas Sinha and family to launch AI college
stories.teaser: Vikas Sinha, a Broadcom executive and UNT doctoral graduate, and his wife Anuradha have committed $20 million to transform the University of North Texas College of Information into the Anuradha and Vikas Sinha College of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics. Sinha discovered UNT after seeing a billboard while working as a vice president and was drawn to the university's willingness to accommodate working…

stories.title: California Gov. Newsom signs 13 laws targeting social media, AI risks for children
stories.teaser: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed 13 new laws on Thursday designed to protect children from dangers associated with social media and artificial intelligence. The centerpiece, Assembly Bill 1709, prohibits social media platforms from offering addictive features like infinite scroll to users under 16, or requires blocking minors from these platforms entirely.

stories.title: Anthropic C.E.O. Calls for A.I. Slowdown
stories.teaser: Dario Amodei, CEO of artificial intelligence company Anthropic, called for the AI industry to slow its development pace on Saturday. He published an essay outlining a three-part plan to address safety concerns and committed his company to the first step, which involves allowing third-party evaluators permanent access to Anthropic's systems to verify safety measures and assess model alignment.

stories.title: AI privacy agreement reached between teachers union and Microsoft
stories.teaser: Microsoft and the American Federation of Teachers have reached an agreement to protect student and teacher privacy when artificial intelligence is used in schools. The deal includes ten legally enforceable protections, with the most significant preventing Microsoft from using student or teacher data to train AI models, except in narrow safety and security situations.

stories.title: Government of Canada launches National AI Literacy Initiative
stories.teaser: The Canadian government launched the National AI Literacy Initiative in partnership with the Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute, a program designed to provide free AI education across the country. The initiative, announced by Minister Evan Solomon on September 9, 2026, targets three groups: post-secondary students, kindergarten through Grade 12 educators, and the general public.

stories.title: IntelliBI Highlights Practical, Project-Based Learning as AI and Data Careers Evolve
stories.teaser: IntelliBI Innovations Technologies, a Pune-based training provider, emphasizes the need for AI and data education to shift from teaching tools to practical problem-solving and enterprise projects. The World Economic Forum projects that 39% of worker skills will transform by 2030, with AI and big data among the fastest-growing capabilities, while 59 of every 100 workers will need training.

stories.title: AI & Automation - the Future of Citizen-Centric Manufacturing MSMEs
stories.teaser: India's manufacturing small and medium enterprises, or MSMEs, face mounting pressure from rising costs, global competition, and strict quality demands. To stay competitive, these businesses must adopt modern technologies, particularly artificial intelligence and automation.

stories.title: Microsoft and teachers unions forged a binding AI privacy standard for U.S. schools
stories.teaser: Microsoft and two major teachers unions, the American Federation of Teachers and the United Federation of Teachers, announced a legally binding AI privacy agreement for U.S. schools on Wednesday. The deal prevents student and educator data from being used to train artificial intelligence models, prohibits student monitoring, requires human oversight in AI-related decisions, and mandates that Microsoft provide clear…

stories.title: U.S. Agencies Accuse Chinese AI Firms of Industrial-Scale IP Theft
stories.teaser: Three U.S. security agencies, including the FBI and National Security Agency, accused six Chinese artificial intelligence companies of stealing American technology on an industrial scale since late 2024, likely with Chinese government knowledge. The firms named are DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI.

stories.title: California Enacts Artificial Intelligence Auditing Laws
stories.teaser: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed two artificial intelligence bills into law on Wednesday, Senate Bill 813 and Assembly Bill 1405, which his office called first-in-the-nation AI safeguards. Senate Bill 813 creates a framework for independent verification organizations to assess AI systems for compliance with state law.

incidents.title: Tesla's Missing Autopilot Data Showed It Detected A Hazard Before Fatal Crash, Despite Claims It Was Missing
incidents.teaser: Neima Benavides and Dillon Angulo sued Tesla after a self-driving Tesla crashed into their parked car, killing Naibel Benavides Leon and seriously injuring Angulo. Tesla claimed it did not have the crash video or snapshot data, but a hacker known as @greentheonly, who had reported software flaws through Tesla's Bug Bounty program for a $15,000 reward, recovered the data and showed Tesla did have access.

incidents.title: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
incidents.teaser: Several female Dutch public figures are considering legal action after manipulated pornographic videos featuring their faces appeared on a website with 13 million monthly visitors. The videos include Dutch artists, TV presenters, Olympic athletes, former ministers, mayors, and members of the royal family.

incidents.title: Justice Department Files to Intervene and Dismiss Lawsuit that Would Hamper America’s AI Innovation and Security
incidents.teaser: I cannot provide a summary of this article because the text you've shared is corrupted PDF code rather than readable article content. The document appears to be a legal notice related to Clean Air Act violations at a gas turbine power plant in Southaven, Mississippi that powers xAI's Colossus II Data Center, but the actual text content is not legible in the format provided.

incidents.title: Cline CLI npm Package Compromised via Suspected Cache Poisoning Attack
incidents.teaser: Cline, an open-source AI coding tool used by millions of developers, contained a critical security vulnerability from December 21, 2025, to February 9, 2026. The flaw existed in an AI-powered issue triage workflow that automatically responded to GitHub issues.

incidents.title: AI scams in Georgia and South Florida: How scammers use deepfakes to steal millions
incidents.teaser: Criminals are increasingly using artificial intelligence to commit scams across Georgia and South Florida by creating deepfakes of voices, photos, and phone calls that sound and look authentic. Recent cases include a South Florida immigration attorney whose voice and identity were cloned to target vulnerable immigrants, and a Cobb County couple who lost approximately $800,000 in a cryptocurrency scam.

incidents.title: Mueller residents upset after self-driving car runs over, kills duck
incidents.teaser: A self-driving car operated by Avride struck and killed a mother duck in the Mueller Lake neighborhood of Austin, Texas, prompting significant community concern about autonomous vehicles. The incident occurred when the vehicle, which was in autonomous mode with a human safety operator present, ran over the duck without slowing down or stopping.
